text: {"lessons":["Stock B kept rising after my early sales, so I won’t treat a big gain over my purchase price as a reason to sell on its own.","My account rose in each of the five periods after my last trade, so I’m comfortable holding when I don’t have a clear reason to act.","I took profits in B, D, and E more readily than I sold laggards. Going forward, I’ll ask the same question of every holding: would I choose to own it at today’s price?"]}
